body.name: cardinality-uniform latent-overlap POMDP experiment class
body.construction: \(\mathcal M_T(t_0,\zeta,C):=\{(\mathcal X,\mathcal H,K,b,e,\mathcal L(\mathsf O_T)): T\in\mathbb N,\ |\mathcal X|<\infty,\ |\mathcal H|<\infty,\ |\mathcal A|=2,\text{ and }\mathrm{A}_{\mathrm{pomdp}},\mathrm{A}_{\mathrm{ign}},\mathrm{A}_{\mathrm{start}},\mathrm{A}_{\mathrm{reward}},\mathrm{A}_{\mathrm{act}},\mathrm{A}_{\mathrm{mix}},\mathrm{A}_{\mathrm{stat}}\text{ hold}\}\), where the seven predicates are exactly \(\mathrm{ass{:}pomdp\text{-}kernel}\) through \(\mathrm{ass{:}latent\text{-}stationary\text{-}overlap}\); the union ranges over all finite cardinalities and all revealed policy pairs.
